### Full Job Description
Summary:
Senior Software Engineer building scalable delivery technology for Gopuff’s on-demand convenience platform. Developing pricing, dispatch, routing, ETA, and Driver App services.
Senior Software Engineer building delivery technology for Gopuff’s on-demand convenience platform
Role description:
• Build and maintain services and solutions for Delivery Technology, including Driver Pay and Pricing, Dispatch and Optimization, ETA and Routing, and the Driver App
• Drive sound technology choices through collaboration with product, engineering, and stakeholders across the company
• Partner with engineering leadership to strategize the technical evolution of projects for future business growth
• Deliver services effectively and make appropriate design tradeoffs
• Mentor other engineers on the team
• Write code following industry practices
• Promote and support Gopuff Engineering’s culture of inclusion and diversity
• Participate in cross-functional projects in an agile environment
• Build, deploy, and maintain code
• Support idiomatic syntax, design patterns, and test-driven development
• Implement and monitor analytics to ensure business-process correctness
• Support production services to maintain reliability and correctness
• Participate in team on-call rotations when necessary
• Participate in code reviews and provide system design feedback
• Raise engineering standards within the team and more broadly
Role requirements:
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science (or relative experience)
• 5+ Years of experience
• Proficiency with modern web, frontend, backend, and/or cloud applications
• Good understanding of Object Oriented concepts
• Experience building highly scalable, high-throughput systems
• Experience creating APIs and extensible systems
• Experience using Go, Java, Python, Flutter, Node.js in a production setting and open to learning other languages
• Experience building microservices in a distributed environment
• Experience with message-based/event-driven architecture with knowledge of asynchronous transactional patterns
• Public cloud experience in a production setting (Azure/GCP)
• Experience in operations, monitoring, and deployment methodologies for distributed systems
Benefits:

• Fitness Reimbursement Program
• 25% employee discount & FAM Membership
• Flexible PTO
• Group Life Insurance
• EAP through AllOne Health (formerly Carebridge)
• Discretionary annual cash bonus
• Participation in Gopuff’s equity incentive plan
Tech stack:
Azure, Cloud, Distributed Systems, Flutter, Google Cloud Platform, Java, JavaScript, Microservices, Node.js, Python, Go
